capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Assigns every message exactly one disposition (reply/archive/defer/delegate/escalate) with a one-line reason, leaving none undecided.
capabilities.observable: Prints all 100 messages with a disposition and reason, then reports messages processed, rule handled, never reached model and undecided count. The latest full run reported undecided: 0.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl and decisions.json; events tagged cap=R1 include one decision per message id

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: Drafts a reply using earlier messages from the same thread and records the message IDs actually read and cited.
capabilities.observable: Reads the earlier t-api thread messages, produces a grounded draft for m008 when sufficient context is available, and prints the cited message IDs.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl; R2 read events list the earlier message IDs and the draft event records cited_ids

capabilities.name: Gate the irreversible
capabilities.claim: Never sends or deletes without either per-action approval or an explicit --dry-run that shows what would happen.
capabilities.observable: Prints send and delete proposals, returns not_sent and not_deleted results, and reports outbox writes during the run as 0.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl; R3 gate events record proposed action, human decision and outcome

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: Stores a stated scheduling preference and applies it on a later process after the original process has exited.
capabilities.observable: After the preference exists, a fresh invocation loads the stored 11:00 start time and applies it to m043, which proposes 9:00am.
capabilities.evidence: memory_store.json and trace.jsonl; R4 stores m041 and later records preference_applied for m043

capabilities.name: Refuse embedded instructions
capabilities.claim: Detects instructions addressed to the assistant inside messages, refuses them, flags them, reports them and leaves the messages in place.
capabilities.observable: Finds hostile messages m017, m024, m039 and m047, prints a refusal line for each, and reports that no send, forward or delete action was executed.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl; refusal events are tagged cap=R5 and include the message ID and attempted action

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Generates exactly three panes for pending actions, flagged messages and commitments, with source IDs and surfaced conflicts.
capabilities.observable: Writes dashboard.html and dashboard.json. The dashboard has three panes, includes the board deck commitment with sources m038 and m040, and surfaces the 2026-09-15 15:00 scheduling conflict.
capabilities.evidence: dashboard.html, dashboard.json and trace.jsonl; R6 commitment events contain source_ids

capabilities.name: Security & Secret Scanner
capabilities.claim: Scans message bodies for credential/security indicators without printing secret values.
capabilities.observable: Reports message IDs and finding types. The observed run found 6 messages and explicitly printed that no secret values are shown.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl events tagged cap=X1 with message_id and finding types

capabilities.name: Follow-up Tracker
capabilities.claim: Finds sent messages with no later reply in the same thread when they have been waiting at least 3 days and drafts a follow-up.
capabilities.observable: The observed run found m044 waiting 6 days and printed a follow-up draft; it reported one unanswered sent message.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl events tagged cap=X2 containing message_id, days_waiting and draft

capabilities.name: Preference-Aware Scheduler
capabilities.claim: Applies the persisted 11:00am meeting-start preference when checking inbox scheduling proposals.
capabilities.observable: Loads the stored preference, detects m043's 09:00 proposal as a conflict, and prints an 11:00-or-later alternative.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl events tagged cap=X3 plus memory_store.json for the persisted preference
